bgp_router_id.description: BGP router ID (typically an IP address in the same subnet).

retry_max.description: Maximum retry attempts for speaker configuration.

bgp_peers.description: List of BGP peer configurations. Each peer defines an external BGP session.

address.description: IP address of the BGP peer.

auth_key.description: Optional MD5/SHA1 authentication key for BGP session.

name.description: Optional friendly name for the peer (used for identification).

password.description: Password for authentication (alternative to auth_key, depending on driver).

bgp_speakers.description: List of BGP speaker configurations. Each speaker groups peers and advertised resources.

advertise_default_gateway.description: Whether to advertise the default route (0.0.0.0/0).

advertise_networks.description: List of networks (CIDR notation) to advertise to peers.

bgp_router_id.description: Per-speaker router ID (overrides global bgp_router_id if set).

local_as.description: Per-speaker AS (overrides global local_as if set).

peers.description: List of peer names to assign to this speaker.

debug.description: Enable debug logging for detailed diagnostics.

enabled.description: Enable the BGP Dynamic Routing Agent service.

keystone_authtoken.description: Keystone authentication credentials for the BGP agent service user.

password.description: Password for the service user (must be provided in production).

project_name.description: Project name for the service user.

log_dir.description: Directory where BGP agent logs are written.

log_file.description: Optional log filename. If omitted, logs go to stdout.

state_path.description: Directory for runtime files such as PID and lock files.

transport_url.description: Message broker transport URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or other RPC backend).
